name: speed-dial
description: Speed dial style web bookmarks with a top search bar (Google by default, switchable Bing/Baidu/DuckDuckGo), groups, drag-and-drop sorting, custom icons, AI batch import from text/files and AI auto-grouping. All data stays local.
author: Mazmot Official

cn.description: Speed Dial 风格的网页收藏夹，顶部搜索引擎搜索框（默认 Google，可切换 Bing/百度/DuckDuckGo），支持分组、拖拽排序、自定义网址图标、AI 从文本/文件批量导入网址、AI 自动分组整理，数据全部保存在本地。
